query: UPDATE meta_messaging_receipt SET status = CASE WHEN $4::integer IS NOT NULL AND attempts < 20 THEN 'pending' WHEN $3::text IS NULL THEN 'complete' ELSE 'failed' END, error_code = $3, available_at = now() + make_interval(secs => COALESCE($4, 0)), lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = $1 AND lease_id = $2 AND lease_until > now() AND status = 'processing'
